class.name: threevn_hardware/Esp32SystemInterface
class.description:
Drives the physical 3VN arm through an ESP32 over a framed binary serial protocol. The control loop runs here on the host at 50 Hz; the device is a servo driver that clamps limits independently.
This class name is referenced by arm.ros2_control.xacro and has been since Phase 1, which is what made Phase 5 purely additive.
